description: This file defines a configuration and transformation class for integrating Fireworks AI's reranking API within a larger machine learning or search framework. It provides methods for constructing API URLs, validating environment setup, mapping parameters, transforming requests and responses, and handling API responses specifically for Fireworks AI's rerank service.

classes.name: FireworksAIRerankConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for interfacing with Fireworks AI's rerank API, providing URL construction, parameter mapping, request transformation, response transformation, and environment validation methods.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL for the reranking request based on provided base URL and model.

methods.name: list get_supported_cohere_rerank_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns the list of supported parameters for Cohere rerank API that are relevant to Fireworks AI.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] map_cohere_rerank_params( self, non_default_params: Optional[dict], model: str, drop_params: bool, query: str, documents: List[Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]], custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, top_n: Optional[int] = None, rank_fields: Optional[List[str]] = None, return_documents: Optional[bool] = True, max_chunks_per_doc: Optional[int] = None, max_tokens_per_doc: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Maps common rerank parameters to Fireworks AI-specific parameters, ignoring unsupported ones.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Validates environment variables and headers, ensuring API keys are set and headers are correctly configured.

methods.name: dict transform_rerank_request( self, model: str, optional_rerank_params: Dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms generic rerank request parameters into the format expected by Fireworks AI.

methods.name: RerankResponse transform_rerank_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: RerankResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_key: Optional[str] = None, request_data: dict = {}, optional_params: dict = {}, litellm_params: dict = {}, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw HTTP response from Fireworks AI into the standard RerankResponse format used internally.
